help.title: Help Center
help.nav_selector_closed: Closed selector: Use Page Down or Page Up to jump between Modules, and Home or End to go to the first or last available chapter of the module.
help.nav_selector_open: Open selector: Behavior depends on your operating system (arrow keys will navigate the dropdown list).
help.nav_text_area: In the text area: Use any arrow key to go backward or forward phrase by phrase. You can also click directly on any phrase to go to it.
help.nav_toolbar: On the bottom bar: Use ← and → to move between buttons. Use ↑ and ↓ to jump between text phrases while keeping the controls in sight.
help.nav_global_jump: Quick jumps: Press Page Down or Page Up from the text or the bottom bar to jump by full paragraphs. And in the configuration menu to jump between control groups.
help.nav_multimedia: Multimedia keyboard: Once chapter playback has started, you can use your device's multimedia keyboard to stop and resume playback or to go forward and backward through phrases.
help.nav_other: Remember that any manual navigation (clicks, taps, etc.) will pause automatic reading. To resume it, just press the play button.
help.nav_screenreader: While automatic playback is active, the chapter's content will be invisible to screen readers to avoid confusion.
help.license_desc: VortexSpira is Freemium. The first chapters are free. To access the rest of the course, you must purchase a license on our official website.
help.license_steps: Once purchased, go to the Manage License tab (key icon) in this panel, enter your purchase email and the provided key to unlock premium content.
help.exam_desc: Certification is managed through Hotmart. Upon finishing your study in the PWA, you will be able to access the platform to take your multiple-choice exam.
help.exam_rules: You need to pass 70% of the questions to obtain your certificate. You have a maximum of 5 attempts. If you exhaust them, the platform will provide a secure link to access a different test at a discounted price.
